description: Emitted E-motion probes for ordinary restart extra and toolchange retract length on a two-filament Type1 tower print, plus direct-writer toolchange restart extra.

mutants.description: The positive 0.2 mm restart extra must produce a 1.0 mm E-only recovery after a 0.8 mm ordinary retract.
mutants.test_filter: ^FocusedGCode::Retraction settings change emitted E moves on the mapped filaments$

mutants.description: The 2.4 mm toolchange retract must remain distinct from the 0.8 mm ordinary retract for filament one.
mutants.test_filter: ^FocusedGCode::Retraction settings change emitted E moves on the mapped filaments$

mutants.description: The direct writer must recover 2.75 mm after a 2.4 mm toolchange retract, using 0.35 mm toolchange extra rather than the 0.2 mm ordinary extra.
mutants.test_filter: ^Toolchange restart extra reaches the direct writer unretract$
